content: React 18->19 migration: recommended path is first upgrade to React 18.3 to surface deprecation warnings, then to 19. Breaking changes include removed PropTypes/defaultProps-on-function-components support, moved JSX namespace (breaks explicit Promise<JSX.Element> return types), and libraries reading React internals (e.g. old Recoil) can break. Vite/build tooling should be current. Verify router/state-mgmt/UI-kit React 19 compatibility individually (react-router 7.18 and Mantine 9.4 already require/support React 19).
